title: [IMP-3] `accessKeyAnnouncement` and the registration-service API do not exist as wire formats
description: Review finding IMP-3: `accessKeyAnnouncement` and the registration-service API do not exist as wire formats (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:203-205; spec/10-relays.md:612-624; spec/13-encoding.md:27 (not :91). Fix: As proposed. "registration service" appears only at 05:203-205, 10:612/624, 14:136 and ARCHITECTURE:181/198/276, and none of these gives an endpoint, field list or relay intake. Constraint from Q6: the locator for the registration service may sit in Space state, but the billing DID must not (10:608). Agreement exchange to the relay also needs an endpoint, because the agreement is private and never gossiped (10:610). Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
